column1: # ZAP alert gating rules — OWASP's own convention (from zap-baseline.py/
# zap-full-scan.py), reused here for run-and-gate.ts's gate.
# - ruleId is ZAP's numeric plugin ID (https://www.zaproxy.org/docs/alerts/)
# - site, optional, is a site name exactly as the report gives it, such as
#   http://localhost:3000: the rule then applies to that site only, and wins
#   over a rule for the same ruleId with no site
# - IGNORE: triaged as a known false positive — stays visible in the report
#   (same as WARN) and does not fail the build; the difference from WARN is
#   documentation only, marking that someone has already looked at it
# - WARN: visible in the report, does not fail the build, not yet triaged
# Unlisted rules default to: FAIL if High risk, WARN otherwise — see
